images.name: logo
images.prompt: A polished square app icon for an AI drawing plugin, themed on Hakurei Reimu from Touhou Project. Centered emblem: a glossy red-and-white yin-yang orb with a big red hair bow with white frilled edges tied on top of it, and a calligraphy paintbrush crossing behind it with a stroke of red ink. A paper ofuda talisman tucked at the side. Warm cream-white background with a soft red rounded-square frame, subtle shrine-paper texture. Clean flat-shaded vector style with gentle highlights, bold readable silhouette at small sizes, red / white / gold palette. No text, no letters, no watermark.

images.name: banner
images.prompt: Wide README banner illustration. {subject}. She sits on the wooden veranda of the Hakurei Shrine painting on a large canvas with a calligraphy brush; magical brush strokes of red light and floating yin-yang orbs swirl out of the canvas and turn into small paintings (a figurine, a pixel sprite, a watercolor landscape) drifting in the air. Red torii gate, cherry blossom petals, donation box (saisen box) beside her, warm late-afternoon light. Keep the left third of the frame calm with soft sky and petals so a title can be placed there. No text, no letters, no watermark.
